newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - New Hanover County, N.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - New Hanover County, N.C..

text.p: General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1996 Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North
Carolina 27603-1385 until 11 o'clock A.M., North Carolina Time,
such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of the Public Improvement Bonds of the County of New Hanover, North Carolina.
Dated November 1, 1996 and maturing (subject to the
right of prior redemption) annually, May 1, as

$550,000 2017. There will be no auction. Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919/733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form.
